meaning: anchor_status says what the method and path of each action rest on: vendor_spec, sdk_method and documented_url name a pinned vendor document, a pinned SDK request or a dated documentation page; captured_only rests on the frozen captured catalog alone and names its capture file; unanchored gives its reason. A native_read that is not anchored carries the advisory read_unanchored. Anchors are evidence only: they never enable, block or reclassify an action.

reasons.captured_catalog_only: Its method and path come only from the frozen captured catalog: no pinned vendor document, SDK request or dated documentation page states them yet.
reasons.sdk_has_no_request: Meta's Python Business SDK 26.0.2 has no request for this route (tests/fixtures/meta-sdk-changes-v26.json), so its method and path come only from the frozen captured catalog.
reasons.not_in_pinned_document: The gateway's pinned vendor document has no method with this route, so its method and path come only from the captured catalog.
reasons.independent_mapping_unpinned: A route AMCP maps itself: the captured catalog does not give it, and no pinned vendor document, SDK request or dated documentation page states it.

normalization: Input digests are the SHA-256 of each file text with CRLF line ends read as LF.
